source.notes: Manuscript-derived facts are GM canon in draft. Invented mock content (PC builds, NPC stats, encounters, secondary NPCs, locations, lore) is tagged generated_draft in metadata. Every GM-only secret is visibility gm, not revealed, and has no knowledge grant.

campaign.name: Shadow of the Mountain (Test Campaign)
campaign.subtitle: Seeded from the manuscript for platform testing

adventure.title: The Shadow of the Mountain
adventure.subtitle: Test campaign adventure
adventure.premise: Dal Riata, a trained killer of the Edhellain council, is pulled from the shadow of the mountain into a web of lineage, politics, and a stolen book.
adventure.background_truth: The Riata royal line was altered in the Priory tower records. The lineage book Dal stole can prove it. Halvern and the Cinth Artificers are moving Chokrah cargo for a purpose the party does not yet know.

adventure_version.changelog_summary: Full mock campaign: nodes, blocks, links, sessions, characters, NPCs, locations, lore, claims, encounters. Draft content, secrets not revealed.

nodes.title: The Shadow of the Mountain
nodes.summary: Full campaign seeded from the manuscript for testing.

nodes.title: Chapter One
nodes.summary: The birth of Emrys, the Council of Nine, and the withdrawal of the gods.

nodes.title: Shadows Above the Throne
nodes.summary: Dal in Dal Riata's palace. Thalen trains him. Dal stops an assassin aiming a poisoned knife at the High Lord's cup.

nodes.title: Edhellain
nodes.summary: Dal's years in the noble house and his council-ordered kills. He leaves before dawn, reaches Vandia, meets Fivi, and enters the Knot & Knife.

nodes.title: Vandia
nodes.summary: Tavern meeting in Vandia with Kildrid, Munk, Bastion Cael, and Kycius. A Priory-marked seal strip. An ambush of eight assassins. Camp on the beach.

nodes.title: The Privateer Estate
nodes.summary: Road bandits. A privateer estate glamour over a cellar with a hidden ship and Chokrah crates. A children's ledger. Bastion steals the ship. The party enters the Study Tower.

nodes.title: The Tower
nodes.summary: Prior Nymor in the Priors' tower. The Moonlight Room and Luminary models. Kildrid's stone responds to the Lodestone. Altered Riata genealogy records. A summons from Lord Decland DuCarth.

nodes.title: The Well
nodes.summary: Decland's wagons to Cinth across the Plains of Red. Jackal-like cultists and a black sack. Halvern's Glass Hall reception and a vampire attack. Katarina Vey is dead. The Sealhouse holds her opened packet.

nodes.title: The Plains of Red
nodes.summary: The journey to Cinth, the cultist encounter, the vampire infiltration of the Glass Hall, and the Sealhouse with Katarina's packet. Emrys is present.

nodes.title: The Guild of Scars
nodes.summary: Sealhouse underlevel with Mera and Arlen Saye. Escape through a service tunnel. Grey-cloaked agents, Laksis, and the Cinth Artificers Guild. Chokrah shipments rise from 12 to 30 casks.

nodes.title: The Grand Illusion
nodes.summary: The Edhellain king tasks the party with protecting a sacred grove. Dal has taken a lineage book. The party is discovered and escapes to an airship waiting in the forest.

nodes.title: The Sacred Grove
nodes.summary: The grove the king assigned the party to guard. The ambush suspicion lives here.

blocks.title: The High Lord's Hall
blocks.content: Lamps burn low over the Riata palace. Silver cups wait on the long table, and the High Lord laughs at something no one else heard.

blocks.title: Thalen's Test
blocks.content: Thalen watches for hesitation. A clean save on the poisoned-knife assassin raises his trust in Dal.

blocks.title: The Knot & Knife
blocks.content: Smoke and brine fill the tavern. A Priory seal strip sits on the table between Kildrid's cup and Munk's dice.

blocks.title: The Eight-Assassin Ambush
blocks.content: Eight assassins wait on the beach road. Two carry Riata crest tokens. Tactics: they spread out, try to isolate Dal, and retreat at half strength.

blocks.title: Altered Genealogy
blocks.content: The Riata records in the tower were edited. The original ink is still under the new ink under UV light. Prior Nymor knows and is not telling.

blocks.title: Read the Ledger
blocks.content: DC 14 Investigation to notice the ink lines do not match the seal dates.

blocks.title: The Plains of Red
blocks.content: Red grass rolls toward the horizon. Decland's wagons creak ahead, and a black sack bounces on the last cart.

blocks.title: Jackal Cultists
blocks.content: Four jackal-like cultists rush from the grass at initiative 2. They target the wagon drivers first, then the closest caster.

blocks.title: The Glass Hall
blocks.content: Glass walls catch the moonlight and throw it back in a thousand shards. Halvern smiles, and the guests do not notice the pale hands at the doors.

blocks.title: Katarina's Packet
blocks.content: Katarina Vey is dead. Her opened packet is in the Sealhouse. It names the Cinth buyer, which the party has not seen yet.

blocks.title: Service Tunnel
blocks.content: Mera and Arlen Saye hold the lower gate. The tunnel exit is watched by grey-cloaked agents led by Laksis.

blocks.title: The Sacred Grove
blocks.content: The Edhellain king's voice carries over the grove. Silver light falls through old oaks, and an airship waits just beyond the trees.

blocks.title: The Lineage Book
blocks.content: The book called to Dal. It may prove the Riata royal line. Dhreg Riata does not know what it contains.

links.label: The party enters the Study Tower
Wagons cross the Plains of Red

sessions.title: Shadows Above the Throne
sessions.epigraph: The cup is always poisoned in the palace.
sessions.summary: The party serves the High Lord and stops the assassin. Dal leaves before dawn for Vandia.

sessions.title: The Knot & Knife
sessions.epigraph: Every seal has a second strip.
sessions.summary: The tavern meeting, the eight-assassin ambush, and the privateer estate cellar.

sessions.title: The Plains of Red
sessions.epigraph: The road to Cinth is red for a reason.
sessions.summary: Decland's wagons cross the Plains of Red. Jackal cultists attack from the grass. The Glass Hall waits ahead.

sessions.title: The Guild of Scars
sessions.epigraph: Nothing leaves the Sealhouse without a ledger.
sessions.summary: The Sealhouse underlevel, the Saye siblings, and the service tunnel escape.

sessions.title: The Grand Illusion
sessions.epigraph: Protect the grove, and do not ask why.
sessions.summary: The sacred grove assignment. The lineage book. The party is discovered and escapes to the airship.

progress.label: Stop the poisoned knife
progress.outcome_notes: Dal caught the assassin's wrist before the cup was lifted.

play_events.summary: Session 1 completed: the banquet and the assassin.
Beach ambush ended: eight assassins engaged.
Session 3 started on the Plains of Red.

locations.name: Edhellain
locations.description: The noble city of the Edhellain council, built in pale stone.
locations.historical_background: Founded by the Council of Nine after the withdrawal of the gods.
locations.culture_and_traditions: Silver cups at every banquet and a strict hierarchy of houses.
locations.local_myths: The palace cup is never poisoned, or so the servants say.

locations.name: Riata Palace
locations.description: The Riata family seat, where Dal trained and killed for the council.
locations.historical_background: Built by the Riata line during the second council.
locations.culture_and_traditions: The High Lord's table is set before every feast.
locations.local_myths: A lineage book is said to sleep in the east wing.

locations.name: Vandia
locations.description: A harbor town on the coast road south of Edhellain.
locations.historical_background: Grew rich on sea trade and smuggling.
locations.culture_and_traditions: Fishermen sing when the boats come in.
locations.local_myths: Drowned bells ring under the harbor at low tide.

locations.name: Knot & Knife
locations.description: A tavern on the harbor where the Priory's seal strips change hands.
locations.historical_background: Built from the hull of a wrecked privateer.
locations.culture_and_traditions: Dice are thrown for the first round.
locations.local_myths: The owner never sleeps in the same room twice.

locations.name: Priory Study Tower
locations.description: The Priors' tower with the Moonlight Room and the Luminary models.
locations.historical_background: The Priory records every Riata marriage.
locations.culture_and_traditions: Priors speak only in written notes.
locations.local_myths: The Luminary models glow when a lie is spoken near them.

locations.name: Plains of Red
locations.description: A grassland of red stalks between Edhellain and Cinth.
locations.historical_background: An old battlefield. The grass never fully grew back.
locations.local_myths: Jackal-headed shadows walk the grass after dusk.

locations.name: Cinth
locations.description: A river city of guilds and glass halls.
locations.historical_background: The Artificers Guild built the city's bridges.
locations.culture_and_traditions: Every guild keeps a ledger of its debts.
locations.local_myths: Nothing leaves Cinth without a ledger entry.

locations.name: Halvern's Glass Hall
locations.description: Halvern's reception hall of mirrored glass, where the vampire attack began.
locations.historical_background: Halvern bought the hall from a bankrupt glassmaker.
locations.culture_and_traditions: Guests are announced by name at the door.
locations.local_myths: The walls remember every face that enters.

locations.name: The Sealhouse
locations.description: The Cinth vault that holds sealed packets and the underlevel tunnels.
locations.culture_and_traditions: Seals are broken only in front of two witnesses.
locations.local_myths: Katarina's packet was opened before it arrived.

locations.name: The Sacred Grove
locations.description: The Edhellain king's grove, guarded by the party in the Grand Illusion.
locations.historical_background: The king's ancestors planted the oaks.
locations.culture_and_traditions: No blade is drawn inside the grove.
locations.local_myths: The grove is said to hide an airship dock.

claims.title: The Riata lineage was altered
claims.statement: The Priory altered the Riata genealogy records in its tower.
claims.gm_canonical_truth: The Priory altered the records in year 412. The ink under the new ink is the original.

claims.title: The lineage book proves the royal line
claims.statement: The stolen lineage book may reveal the Riata family as the true royal line.
claims.gm_canonical_truth: The book does prove the royal line. Dhreg does not know.

claims.title: The grove assignment is an ambush
claims.statement: The king's grove assignment may be an ambush.
claims.gm_canonical_truth: Suspicion only. The king did not plan an ambush. Halvern's guild does.

claims.title: Chokrah shipments are rising
claims.statement: Chokrah shipments rose from 12 to 30 casks.
claims.gm_canonical_truth: Confirmed in the Cinth ledgers. The Artificers Guild moves the cargo.

lore.title: The Council of Nine
lore.subtitle: Founding history
lore.excerpt: After the gods withdrew, nine councillors founded Edhellain.
lore.content: The Council of Nine governed Edhellain from its founding. Each councillor held one house seat, and the houses still hold them.

lore.title: House Riata
lore.subtitle: Royal pretenders
lore.excerpt: A house with a contested claim to the throne.
lore.content: House Riata has served the council for generations. Its claim to the royal line is not accepted by all.

lore.title: Chokrah
lore.subtitle: Trade cargo
lore.excerpt: A cargo of unknown purpose that moves along the river.
lore.content: Chokrah is shipped in sealed casks. The Cinth ledgers record the counts but not the contents.

lore.title: Katarina's Packet
lore.subtitle: Sealhouse evidence
lore.excerpt: An opened packet that names a buyer in Cinth.
lore.content: The packet was opened before it reached the Sealhouse. The buyer's name is written in Priory script.

lore.title: The Grand Illusion
lore.subtitle: Sacred grove
lore.excerpt: The grove is protected by old oaks and a king's word.
lore.content: The grove is planted by the first king and guarded by silver mist. Few have seen the airship dock beneath it.
